title: ElevenLabs Speech to Text Scribe v2
description: Use Scribe-V2 from ElevenLabs to do blazingly fast speech to text inferences!

pricing.text: Your request will cost $0.008 per input audio minutes. If keyterm is used, you request will cost %30 more.

inputs.name: audio
inputs.tooltip: URL of the audio file to transcribe

inputs.name: language_code
inputs.tooltip: Language code of the audio Empty leaves it out.

inputs.name: tag_audio_events
inputs.tooltip: Tag audio events like laughter, applause, etc.

inputs.name: diarize
inputs.tooltip: Whether to annotate who is speaking

inputs.name: keyterms
inputs.tooltip: Words or sentences to bias the model towards transcribing. Up to 100 keyterms, max 50 characters each. Adds 30% premium over base transcription price. JSON. Empty leaves it out.
